mapper.select: SELECT A.id, A.member_id, A.job_id, COALESCE(J.company_name, C.company_name) AS company_name, J.title AS job_title, M.name AS applicant_name, M.phone, M.email, A.employment_type, A.status, A.created_at, A.updated_at FROM job_application A JOIN job_posting J ON J.id = A.job_id JOIN member M ON M.id = A.member_id LEFT JOIN company_profile C ON C.member_id = J.company_member_id WHERE A.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY A.created_at DESC, A.id DESC

SELECT A.id, A.member_id, A.job_id, COALESCE(J.company_name, C.company_name) AS company_name, J.title AS job_title, M.name AS applicant_name, M.phone, M.email, A.employment_type, A.status, A.created_at, A.updated_at, A.cover_letter FROM job_application A JOIN job_posting J ON J.id = A.job_id JOIN member M ON M.id = A.member_id LEFT JOIN company_profile C ON C.member_id = J.company_member_id WHERE J.company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND J.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY A.created_at DESC, A.id DESC
